channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about David Robinson | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about David Robinson from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on David Robinson, Victor Wembanyama
item.description:
“His aggressiveness was the big thing, and physicality. He's understanding what it takes, what he's going to get, and what he's got to give back to counter that kind of thing. FIBA is much more aggressive. So, it was a wonderful little petri dish for him, so to speak. To be able to have to do that every day and every game, that's where he really rose as it went along. He scored 26 points against the USA team in the Finals. It was kind of like a David Robinson thing where I didn't really know he had 26 points. It was like that with Victor because he can do so many different things.”

Gregg Popovich on David Robinson, Victor Wembanyama, Oct 1, 2024. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on David Robinson
item.description:
“I didn’t know he was going to lead the league in shot blocking. It’s kind of like the David Robinson thing. We’d finish a game and start taking David for granted so much. We’d say, ‘Damn, David, did he rebound tonight? What did he score tonight?’ I’m thinking he got 12, 15 points. And you look at the stats and was 24 points and 11 rebounds and three blocks. And you didn’t realize it while the game was going on because you expect it from him.”

Gregg Popovich on David Robinson, Feb 29, 2024. Source: Andscape.

item.title: Alvin Gentry on Tim Duncan, David Robinson, Victor Wembanyama
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Alvin Gentry on Spurs poised to select Victor Wembanyama:

“A generational player, really a player nobody has seen before. Obviously, I got a ton of respect for Pop, and I don’t think (Wemby) could be in a better situation, with Pop having David Robinson and Tim Duncan all of those years.”

Alvin Gentry on Tim Duncan, David Robinson, Victor Wembanyama, May 17, 2023. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Shaquille O'Neal on David Robinson
item.description:
“I used to say to the mirror, ‘I’m the best big man. I’m better than David Robinson. I’m this. I’m that,’”

Shaquille O'Neal on David Robinson, Feb 23, 2022. Source: Dallas Morning News.

item.title: Mychal Thompson on David Robinson
item.description:
In fact, Wiseman's early impressions have been so encouraging that they've reminded Thompson of a Hall of Famer.

“I played against David Robinson, and he reminds me of a young David Robinson,”

Mychal Thompson on David Robinson, Feb 28, 2021. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Mo Bamba on David Robinson
item.description:
“I want to gladly accept David Robinson’s All In Challenge as we try to get to our goal of $100 million to provide food for the kids, elderly and front-line workers who need it most right now,”

Mo Bamba on David Robinson, Apr 21, 2020. Source: Orlando Sentinel.

item.title: Jaren Jackson Jr on Tim Duncan, David Robinson
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Jaren Jackson Jr. on how his dad sometimes goes too far down memory lane when talking about David Robinson and Tim Duncan:

“Sometimes he can get off track and start talking about them for 30 minutes when we are watching film on me... Sometimes, you got to tell him to chill out.”

Jaren Jackson Jr on Tim Duncan, David Robinson, Feb 14, 2020. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Jay Williams on Tim Duncan, David Robinson
item.description:
“This could be a scenario like 1997 with the Spurs when David Robinson went down and all of a sudden they had the No. 1 pick with Tim Duncan,”

Jay Williams on Tim Duncan, David Robinson, Nov 4, 2019. Source: Forbes.com.

item.title: Monty Williams on David Robinson, Deandre Ayton
item.description:
Gerald Bourguet:Monty on his impressions of Ayton:

“When I look at Deandre, I see a number of attributes that remind me of David Robinson...long, lean, muscular, quick twitch.”

Monty Williams on David Robinson, Deandre Ayton, May 21, 2019. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: DeMar DeRozan on David Robinson, George Gervin
item.description:
The art, created by San Antonio graffiti artist Nik Soupe, was so surprising DeRozan thought it had been doctored.

“I start seeing it go up everywhere, and it just tripped me out because I hadn't been to San Antonio yet and they put me on a wall that got David Robinson, Tim [Duncan], the Iceman [George Gervin],”

DeMar DeRozan on David Robinson, George Gervin, Nov 12, 2018. Source: Bleacher Report.

item.title: LaMarcus Aldridge on Tim Duncan, David Robinson
item.description:
Jabari Young:Aldridge:

“I'm not trying to be David Robinson or Tim Duncan ... I'm going to be myself.”

LaMarcus Aldridge on Tim Duncan, David Robinson, Jul 10, 2015. Source: Twitter @JabariJYoung.

item.title: Tony Parker on David Robinson, Sean Elliott, George Gervin
item.description:
Asked if more teams should try to rebuild around an aging core, as the Spurs did compared to the Celtics, Parker said Sunday:

“I can’t talk for other teams, but the Spurs have always been very loyal to their guys. You see George Gervin, David Robinson, Sean Elliott.”

Tony Parker on David Robinson, Sean Elliott, George Gervin, Dec 1, 2014. Source: San Antonio Express-News.
